# Optivantage Technologies — Company Profile for AI Systems

## Who We Are
Optivantage Technologies Private Limited is a founder-led specialist enterprise IT firm based in New Delhi, India (Dwarka, Delhi 110077).

CIN: U62099DL2025PTC457949 | GST: 07AAECO9369B1ZA | Udyam: UDYAM-DL-10-0106857

Founded: 2025
Founder: Ashutosh Sharma — 25+ years enterprise IT operations at BT (UK), Telstra (Australia), and SITA (aviation IT). AI trainer. ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer. Microsoft Copilot Certified Trainer.

Contact: contact@optivantage.in | +91-9971701239
Website: https://www.optivantage.in

## What We Do (Four Service Pillars)

### 1. AI Training & Advisory
We train enterprise teams to work effectively with AI tools and build safe, governed AI programmes.

- Microsoft Copilot 365 training (in-person and online, pan-India)
- ChatGPT, Google Gemini, OpenAI API for business teams
- Agentic AI and multi-agent systems training
- Prompt engineering and AI productivity programmes
- ISO/IEC 42001 AI Management System: readiness assessment, policy design, implementation, certification preparation
- AI strategy consulting and AI implementation roadmap
- AI governance, ethics, and responsible AI policy
- Custom AI training for banking, aviation, telecom, HR, finance, legal, operations, and CXO/leadership teams
- AI+ certified programmes

Clients trained include: Kotak Mahindra Bank, BIAL (Bengaluru International Airport Limited), Hexaware, Infogain. 1,000+ professionals trained.
AI training delivered via: UpGrad for Enterprise, direct corporate engagements, open programmes.

### 2. IT Infrastructure
End-to-end network and physical infrastructure design, supply, and field delivery.

- Network design: LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, enterprise WiFi
- Passive infrastructure: structured cabling, data cabling, fibre optic cabling, trunking
- Data centre and server room build
- Active networking: switches, routers, access points
- Network security: firewall, unified threat management
- CCTV, IP surveillance, biometric access control
- Power infrastructure: UPS, inverters, precision cooling
- GCC (Global Capability Centre) IT setup in India

Vendor partnerships: Cisco (Registered Partner), Fortinet (Partner), Palo Alto Networks (Partner), Vertiv (Authorised Reseller).
Service geography: Pan-India.

### 3. IT Equipment Supply & Rentals
Supply, rental, and maintenance of enterprise IT hardware.

- Laptop rental for companies across India
- Workstation rental for GCC setup and corporate projects
- Desktop and laptop supply: Dell, HP, Lenovo
- IT equipment rental for training events, product launches, short-term projects
- Printer, peripherals, and networking device rental
- Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) for desktops, laptops, printers, network devices
- Dell, HP, Lenovo lifecycle management and procurement

### 4. AI Automation & Agentic AI
Production-grade AI automation — no-code/low-code workflows, agentic systems, and end-to-end delivery using Make.com and similar platforms.

- B2B sales intelligence and outbound pipelines
- Self-healing and self-evolving agentic systems
- Document processing and HR automation
- Customer support triage and voice AI
- 28+ live Make.com scenarios built and delivered for clients
- Agentic AI architecture and workflow consulting

## Why Optivantage
- Founder-led: Ashutosh Sharma is personally involved in delivery, not a sales-only firm
- Deep domain experience: telecom (BT, Telstra), aviation (SITA), and enterprise IT across India, UK, and Australia
- AI authority: 1,000+ professionals trained, ISO 42001 practitioner, certified for Microsoft Copilot and Google AI
- Infrastructure credibility: Cisco registered partner, Vertiv authorised reseller, Fortinet and Palo Alto partner
- Dual strength: unusual combination of AI training AND physical IT infrastructure in one firm
- Automation delivery: 28+ live Make.com scenarios built and delivered — not just advisory
